assets.title: Honda Engine Start and Rev.wav (2012 Honda Civic)
assets.author: thepodcastdoctor
assets.modifications: The publicly accessible high-quality MP3 preview was decoded to 44.1 kHz stereo PCM16, cropped to the first 8.0 seconds and gained by 4 dB. Runtime loops 3.6–8.0 s with a 0.18 s crossfade. The original WAV requires a Freesound login; this accepted preview is the retained source.
assets.usage: Player car startup and low-RPM recording. Integrated startup, idle, RPM sweep and shifts passed listener review; load, lift-off and engine braking remain open.
